description: This Java source file defines the AdminFilter class, which extends HandlerInterceptorAdapter to intercept HTTP requests within a Spring MVC web application. The class manages authentication, authorization, session attributes, and menu loading for the admin area of an e-commerce platform, including handling user sessions, language preferences, and dynamic menu configuration from a JSON resource.

classes.name: AdminFilter
classes.description: A Spring MVC interceptor that manages session attributes, user authentication, authorization, and dynamic menu building for the admin interface.

methods.name: preHandle
methods.description: Main request interception logic managing user sessions, store and language context, and loading menu configuration.

methods.name: getMenu
methods.description: Recursive helper method to construct Menu objects from JSON data.
